scope: Euler cylinder path words, physical tensors, support, reflection, scalar primitives, and representatives
method: Direct source inspection with declaration/import anchors and token scan

records.finding: Constructs finite translation-word and derivative paths with orbit, ae, pointwise, Sobolev, block, majorant, and time-derivative results. No selected field or five-observable equality.
Pulls cylinder fields back through graph coordinates, proves smoothness, and bounds iterated physical derivatives. No radial moment or pressure-Poisson transport.
Transfers pointwise and difference bounds for physical tensors from ae hypotheses. No selected endpoint or moment observable.
Proves graph-word and physical-tensor Lp membership and norm bounds. Lp control does not imply global radial identities.
Proves representative support containment and compact support under compactness hypotheses. No moment cancellation.
Defines measure-preserving reflection and proves isometry, translation, derivative, test, and gradient identities. No selected Cartesian transport.
Builds retract-based pointwise representatives and proves continuity, smoothness, ae equality, and time derivatives. No selected candidate or five-moment tuple.
Proves scalar angular mean-zero for the scalar primitive construction. This is not the paper's five cumulative radial identity.
Defines the classical scalar angular primitive and proves cover, mean-zero, smoothness, continuity, and zero-input identities. No selected pressure endpoint.
Proves joint-even parity of the classical scalar primitive. Parity does not identify selected-field radial observables.
Defines scalar embedding/projection and primitive operators with norm, translation, path smoothness, and block-bound results. No selected-field bridge.
Proves smooth embedding and ae/constructed-field agreement for the scalar primitive. Exact representative agreement is not selected Navier-Stokes transport.

absence_boundary: No declaration in this tranche mentions barMoment, FiveRowRank, PositiveOrderMoments, selected_witness, CandidateProperties, or an equality identifying a final Cartesian field with (M,I,J,S,C_p). This is tranche-level evidence, not repository-wide nonexistence proof.
